distinct_unit_comparison.2472: Unbounded growth from the smallest concise dimension, using generic column-selection product bounds and a third tensor power restricted to matrix multiplication.
distinct_unit_comparison.2473: Maximal fixed-third-dimension subrank as one other dimension grows, using simultaneous diagonalization/minimum-rank amplification and mixed tensor factors; the general cube-root bound gives no such narrow-regime conclusion.
distinct_unit_comparison.shared_context: Tensor restriction/conciseness/asymptotic definitions only; these receive no counts.

difficulty_reason: The argument relates maximal ranks in different slice directions through simultaneous polynomially generic column selections. Conciseness forces the product of each pair of slice-span ranks to dominate the remaining dimension. A third tensor power restricts to a matrix-multiplication tensor whose asymptotic subrank transfers those pairwise bounds back to the original tensor.
ordinary_named_prerequisites: Schwartz-Zippel polynomial nonvanishing and precise Strassen field-extension/matrix-multiplication asymptotic subrank prerequisites
